My Last Exhibition

Dedicated to My Grandmother

When:

September 4 to October 1, 2022

Where:

Gryphon Café in downtown Wayne, PA (map)

What:

You are invited to view and chill at the most popular café in the affluent Main Line area outside of Philadelphia, with the September featured photographer Hiatt Zhao.
He's dedicating this exhibition to honor his late grandmother.

All photos are for sale from $0 to $1,000,000 (more details).

Meet Hiatt inside Gryphon Café from 9 AM to 12 noon from September 4 through September 16 September 14 for free photographs, or by appointment at hiattzhao@gmail.com.

Public Opening Reception:

September 10 (Saturday) from 3 to 5 PM at Gryphon Café in Wayne, PA (map)
